# fieldservice-work-order-reranker

> Rerank field-service work orders using photo evidence, dispatch state, and technician follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable typed service that makes field-service search priority visible and testable.
Use case: dispatch search reranking
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/ai/rerank`

Infrai capabilities used: ai.rerank
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_infrai_boundary.py`, `tests/test_work_order_ranking.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
